user_saw: Model pickers and defaults offered unavailable models, so affected requests failed or, in some DeepInfra cases, were served by a different model.
summary: The fix removes 35 unavailable models from bundled catalogs and switches affected onboarding and image-understanding defaults to available models.
reasoning: The July Cerebras default change documents Gemma 4 31B as a then-current public preview recommended by Cerebras. The October provider probes found that endpoint archived and recorded explicit retirement or end-of-life responses from Ollama Cloud and NVIDIA, so provider-side availability changes explain the stale catalog entries.
